rationale: RA3 is the abstention this practice's new predicate kind makes possible. Synthea's own chart from the same run as RA1's, carrying an active rheumatoid arthritis condition - so criterion (a) is MET on the same arithmetic - and no methotrexate order anywhere in the bundle, active or otherwise. Criterion (b) therefore abstains with NO_EVIDENCE_RETRIEVED and never answers NOT_MET: L35677 itself covers a patient unable to tolerate methotrexate whose reason is documented in the record, this system does not read that record, and a chart that records no prescription has not recorded that the patient is not taking the drug (D40's asymmetry, carried to medications by D111). The overall INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is (b)'s and the three unclaimed criteria's together, and the gap list names what a human still owes. Note-free for RA1's reason.
